exports.description: Establishes the actual read-only state of a software repository before planning, continuation, recovery, or implementation. Use when inheriting a repo, resuming work, reconciling status claims, or when documentation, branches, tests, or completion claims may be stale.
exports.compatibility: Requires repository read access and a coding-agent harness capable of reading files and Git state. Read-only shell or test execution is optional. Repository mutation requires separate authorization after the audit is complete.
